responsibility: Defines the SH backend’s machine-description operand constraints used by instruction recognition, reload, and register allocation. It assigns register classes, immediate ranges, symbolic and vector constant forms, and SH-specific memory-addressing constraints—including GBR, displacement, index, pc-relative, atomic-sequence-safe, and T/FPU-related forms—so patterns in sh.md and sync.md can precisely describe which RTL operands are legal for each SH instruction variant.
